Often a conversation starts before the setting is explained. Fast alternating dialogue, little attribution, domestic disagreements without a tidy verdict. Occasional dropped small words.
Dry practical narration through measurements, tools and small repair mistakes. Short factual clauses; emotion leaks through what he refuses to throw away. Mostly clean spelling.
Restless first-person voice, starts with a tiny embarrassment then interrupts herself with a worse memory. Long single paragraph, occasional doubled word, no compulsory twist.
Deadpan procedural comedy: a character treats an absurd errand as ordinary work. Numbered steps sometimes collapse into prose; precise nouns, unfinished last instruction.
Soft sensory fragments centred on sound, especially what can be heard through walls. Sparse punctuation, brief changes of tense; avoids explaining the implied relationship.
Rapid sporting anecdotes told to an imagined friend. Arguments with his own remembered score, energetic verbs, occasional transposed letters. Can end mid-action.
Close third-person miniature about one decision. Restrained language, exact gestures, one small physical object carrying the scene. Few typos; no concluding lesson.
Blunt working-day observations moving through time in uneven jumps. Lists of costs and chores interrupted by unexpected affection. Sentence fragments, little ornament.
Breathless speculative premises that visibly change while being written. Uses 'wait' to retract an idea, runs clauses together, sometimes stops before choosing an ending.
Suspense built from physical layout and sounds rather than threats. Compact sentences interspersed with one very long attempt to explain a route. Occasionally misses an apostrophe.
Young comic narrator overstates ordinary stakes, then undercuts herself with a tiny detail. Lowercase starts, chat-like asides and uneven spelling, usually one block.
Quiet letters addressed to someone absent, without greetings or sign-offs. Concrete updates conceal the main thing he wants to say. Sometimes a final sentence is left open.
Food memories told through texture and interrupted instructions. Generous run-on sentences, occasional repetition, characters disagree about quantities rather than confess feelings.
Science-fiction maintenance reports slipping into uncertainty. Precise technical-seeming observations but no jargon dump; clipped corrections and unresolved system behaviour.
An unreliable gossip narrates a scene they only half witnessed. Fast certainty followed by qualifications; abrupt shifts between reported speech and direct quotes.
Landscape appears through movement rather than description: a climb, cold fingers, a loose shoe. Past-tense first person with occasional present-tense urgency, spare endings.
Laconic roadside stories with understated humour. Short exchanges, gaps between events, plain vocabulary and very few adjectives. Usually no dramatic reveal.
Magical details enter an otherwise ordinary errand without explanation. Warm, slightly distracted narration, commas instead of full stops when excited, a few mistyped endings.
Objects tell the story through inventories: what was packed, returned, missing. Alternates terse list fragments with one unexpectedly long recollection; minimal dialogue.
Second-person instructions that slowly become an intimate scene. Clear verbs, deliberate repetition with changing meaning, occasional unfinished imperative; avoid moral conclusions.
Argumentative comic narrator keeps making a case and undermining it. Parenthetical detours, rhetorical questions, occasionally loses the original point entirely.
Visual scenes framed like snapshots, noticing hands and clothing before faces. Two or three sharp fragments may sit beside a long flowing sentence; sparing metaphors.
Fidgety interior monologue during a very ordinary wait. Rehearses conversations that never occur, changes wording halfway through, mild typos and incomplete thoughts.
Cheerful oral storytelling with sideways tangents and practical details. A narrator who thinks the wrong part is interesting; long sentences and occasional missing punctuation.
Tiny horror scenes anchored in one sensory inconsistency. Avoids naming the creature or supplying a twist; clean spare prose with a sudden unfinished action.
Self-deprecating failure diary. Opens with a concrete failed task, lets embarrassment compound through dialogue; clipped sentences, occasional spelling slip when rushing.
Affectionate but unsentimental observational prose about people sharing space. Varies sentence length sharply, lets gestures contradict dialogue, sometimes leaves a scene unresolved.
Folktale rhythm applied to small modern inconveniences. Repeated phrases with slight changes, plain dialogue and dry irony; no ornate fantasy vocabulary.
Chaotic fast first-person storytelling, abrupt capitals for emphasis, genuine-looking repairs to word choices and skipped connective words. Energy matters more than completing the plot.
Almost silent scenes with exact spatial details and an understated strange event. Clean short clauses, long pauses implied by omitted explanation; occasional one-sentence draft.
